## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: When this story is complete, `command -v duckdb` exits 0 and `duckdb --version` returns a version string (confirmed: v1.5.3 installed).

## Implementation Notes

Create `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-duckdb.sh` to satisfy the failing test created in task 2607-71e6-0c01-44e9. Required behavior:

1. Run `command -v duckdb` — if it exits non-zero, emit a remediation message (containing one of: `remediat`, `install`) and exit non-zero (exit code 1 is fine).
2. Otherwise, run `duckdb --version` and capture the output. Emit a single line that includes both an `OK` marker and the version string. Exit 0.

### Structure
- Mirror `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh` (existing) — `set -euo pipefail`, header comment block describing purpose and exit codes.
- `chmod +x plugins/dso/scripts/verify-duckdb.sh` at creation time (per CLAUDE.md `always:chmod-x-new-sh`).
- Use `command -v duckdb` (bash builtin) — NO external dependency such as `which`, `apt-get`, `brew`.
- ShellCheck must pass with no warnings.

### Test transition (RED → GREEN)
The RED test created in task 2607 must flip from failing to passing once this implementation lands. No test modifications are permitted in this task.

### Sibling pattern reference
- `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh` (existing) — structural template.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Script `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-duckdb.sh` exists, is executable, and uses `set -euo pipefail`
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/verify-duckdb.sh && head -5 plugins/dso/scripts/verify-duckdb.sh | grep -q 'set -euo pipefail'
- [ ] Behavioral test now passes (GREEN) — both branches covered
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-verify-duckdb.sh
- [ ] Script uses `command -v duckdb` (bash builtin) — no new external dependency introduced
  Verify: grep -q 'command -v duckdb' plugins/dso/scripts/verify-duckdb.sh && ! grep -E 'which duckdb|apt-get|brew install' plugins/dso/scripts/verify-duckdb.sh
- [ ] ShellCheck passes on the new script
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/verify-duckdb.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Escalation Policy
Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: GREEN: Implement verify-duckdb.sh to pass the behavioral test
